name: io.github.charry99/cf-workers-mcp
title: Cloudflare Workers MCP Server
description: Inspect Cloudflare Workers from Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients — read-only.

environmentVariables.name: CF_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Cloudflare API token with Workers read permission. Required for account tools; the status-check tool works without it.

environmentVariables.name: CF_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Cloudflare account ID that owns the Workers to inspect.
